summary: KING Art's stand-alone hex-based strategy game, positioned as a modern successor to Battle Isle-style turn-based tactics.

entries.title: Battle Worlds: Kronos
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Trains DLC

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the primary route.

primary.version: Windows PC release with Trains DLC
primary.why: Windows is the original, highest-fidelity, and most capture-friendly route, and the complete package includes the Trains DLC campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version and include the Trains DLC, which adds the third campaign and extra units/maps.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; later ports include/convey the same core content for other devices.
